\newcommand{\PaperTitle}{How Much Product Data Is Enough?}
\newcommand{\PaperSubtitle}{Measuring Attribute Saturation in LLM-Based Product Discovery}

\newcommand{\PaperAbstract}{We study how product-discovery quality changes as truthful, schema-valid product representations become progressively richer. Using ShoppingBench as the primary benchmark and WebShop for replication, we measure marginal attribute value, saturation, and possible degradation across lexical, dense, and LLM-based discovery pipelines.}
